payload.text: pplr#0001's adoption unit, spec Pplr ISSUE:0001 at f7cb32b (devbin-vc's brief at 723e426, plus its build need: a bare bin/devbin build builds release): pplr use, pplr install and pplr version go (a CHANGELOG divergence for version), with build.rs and src/install.rs's tree code; bin/devbin install, use and doctor take over; pplr --version prints T4's line from the core's stamp. Released when: a devbin release carries devbin#0326, Pplr vendors it with bin/devbin upgrade, and devbin-vc gives the word. Then: build to 0001, and to devbin#0326 and ccusage#0007's agreed parts where 0001 is silent, asking devbin-vc where those are silent too (eg whether -v stays); runs booked on devbin-vc's desk; pplr-vc reads the diff.
